title.zh: 软骨鱼类来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Chondrichthyes to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开软骨鱼类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Chondrichthyes time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的软骨鱼类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare maghriboselache and cosmoselachus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较maghriboselache与cosmoselachus；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open the approximately 439 Ma Rongxi Formation window for the Qianodus tooth-whorl sample in the map and inspect its source-bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约 4.39 亿年前荣溪组黔齿鱼齿旋样本的时间窗口，检查其有来源边界的出现背景。

limitations: The routed point represents twenty-three isolated tooth whorls from the late Aeronian Rongxi Formation at Leijiatun, Guizhou; no articulated body or jaw links the whorls to a complete individual, and the sample does not establish a global FAD, LAD, direct ancestry or complete distribution.

description.en: Open the approximately 439 Ma Rongxi Formation window for the Fanjingshania dermoskeletal sample in the map and inspect its source-bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约 4.39 亿年前荣溪组梵净山鱼皮骨骼样本的时间窗口，检查其有来源边界的出现背景。

limitations: The routed point follows the late Aeronian Rongxi Formation material from Leijiatun, Guizhou, including a holotype and referred dermal elements; these are discrete dermoskeletal samples rather than one articulated body, and the record does not establish a global range, direct ancestry or complete distribution.

description.en: Open the approximately 436 Ma Huixingshao Formation window for the Shenacanthus holotype in the map and inspect its source-bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约 4.36 亿年前回星哨组盾甲鱼正模的时间窗口，检查其有来源边界的出现背景。

limitations: The routed point is the single near-complete holotype IVPP V300000 from the Huixingshao Formation at Yongdong, Xiushan, Chongqing; one specimen preserves an unusual body-plan mosaic but cannot establish species duration, population variation, a global FAD or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 格拉德巴赫鱼镶嵌解剖产地

description.en: Open the approximately 385 Ma Upper Givetian Lower Plattenkalk window for the Gladbachus specimen in the map and inspect its source-bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约 3.85 亿年前吉维特阶上部下板岩组格拉德巴赫鱼标本的时间窗口，检查其有来源边界的出现背景。

limitations: The routed point represents the single compressed specimen UMZC 2000.32 from Lower Plattenkalk at Unterthal, Bergisch Gladbach; CT and histology expose several anatomical systems, but compression, missing tail material and matrix-sensitive placement limit inference about ecology, global range, direct ancestry or a complete body.

description.en: Open the 369.5–369 Ma Famennian Thylacocephalan Layer window for the Maghriboselache Moroccan sample in the map and inspect its source-bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 3.695—3.69 亿年前法门期甲壳层宽吻鱼摩洛哥样本的时间窗口，检查其有来源边界的出现背景。

limitations: The interval is limited to several partly articulated specimens from the Thylacocephalan Layer of the southern Maïder and Tafilalt, eastern Anti-Atlas, Morocco; neurocrania, fins and one stomach-content event are distributed across specimens, so the sample does not establish a complete distribution, global FAD/LAD, direct ancestry or general behaviour.

description.en: Open the approximately 326 Ma Late Mississippian Fayetteville Shale window for the Cosmoselachus holotype in the map and inspect its source-bounded occurrence context.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约 3.26 亿年前晚密西西比世费耶特维尔页岩宇宙鲨正模的时间窗口，检查其有来源边界的出现背景。

limitations: The routed point is the partial holotype AMNH FF 20509 from the Fayetteville Shale near Cove Creek, Searcy County, Arkansas; CT reveals branchial and jaw anatomy but the partial single specimen cannot establish a complete body, species duration, global distribution, direct ancestry or behaviour.
